changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfileSample') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSample]( [ID] [BIGINT] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetDataProfileID] BIGINT NOT NULL, [SampleType] NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, [Value] NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDataProfileSample] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID], AssetDataProfileID), CONSTRAINT [FK_AssetDataProfileSample_AssetDataProfile] FOREIGN KEY (AssetDataProfileID) REFERENCES AssetDataProfile(ID) ) END
